<thought>Gholdengo runs Choice Scarf to revenge-kill and Trick onto walls, while Garchomp is a Focus Sash Stealth Rock lead with max speed and attack. Dragonite uses Multiscale with Lum Berry for a safe Dragon Dance sweep backed by Extreme Speed priority. Kingambit is the late-game cleaner with Swords Dance, Black Glasses-boosted Kowtow Cleave and Sucker Punch; Rotom-Wash pivots with Leftovers, Will-O-Wisp and Volt Switch; Annihilape with ChestoRest Bulk Up and Rage Fist punishes passive or physical attackers, rounding out a balanced offense with strong defensive backbones.</thought>
